statutory_parameter: 2026 Minimum Wage Hourly, 209-Hour Basis & Monthly Benchmark
threshold_value: Hourly: KRW 10,320 | Monthly Hours: 209 hours | Monthly Result: KRW 2,156,880
calculation_basis_and_statutory_rule: 2026 Statutory Hourly Minimum Wage: KRW 10,320/hour (+2.9% vs 2025 KRW 10,030/hr) | Standard Monthly Paid-Hours Calculation Basis: 209 hours [(40 regular weekly hours + 8 paid weekly holiday hours) / 7 × (365 / 12) = 208.57 rounded to 209 hours] | Explicit Formula: KRW 10,320 × 209 hours = KRW 2,156,880 | Benchmark Rule: KRW 2,156,880 is the standard monthly minimum-wage benchmark (statutory floor), NOT a guaranteed complete E-9 salary. Does NOT include overtime, night premiums, holiday premiums, or bonuses.
statutory_reference: Minimum Wage Act Arts. 4–6 / MOEL Public Notice No. 2025-47 (2025-08-05)
